# Xiolaet

> Xiolaet (pronounced Ksee-oh-LAH-et) is an alien pop artist with an original melodic language.

Her music spans electropop, dance-pop and idol-pop. This is her official music website. For now, she has chosen to let the songs speak first.

## Website

- [Home](/): Artist introduction and featured music.
- [About Xiolaet](/about/): Musical identity, pronunciation, voice and language.
- [Releases](/releases/): The current track catalog.
- [LIREVA by Xiolaet](/releases/lireva/): Official artwork, track notes, release date and listening links.

## LIREVA

LIREVA is presented as Xiolaet’s first signal: a voice reaching across the unknown. The official track description asks, “What if this song was meant to find you?” Its title is from her original melodic language. The working meaning relates to answering or responding; this is not a final lyric translation. LIREVA was released on 13 November 2026. The official cover is supplied by DistroKid. Listen: [Amazon Music](https://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B0HPPDMSDJ), [Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/track/1IL6bCJ4yeOSnDIirAQeHQ), [YouTube Music](https://music.youtube.com/watch?v=0c-C7kDxue0), [Apple Music](https://music.apple.com/us/album/lireva-single/6828435850). No additional releases are listed.

## Record label

Molotko Media Group.
